movers.quantum: ~USD 210 mn (≈Rs 2,000 cr — our conversion); ~6% of mcap
movers.headline: signs a **supply agreement for high-density optical fibre cable worth approximately USD 210 mn**, to be executed over **three calendar years, CY27–29**. The counterparty is disclosed only as a *"leading telecom infrastructure company"* and is international, so the revenue is FX-linked and back-ended — nothing lands in FY27. **The filing states no rupee equivalent.** Two other filings on the same tape do convert (Panacea Biotec: USD 8.205 mn ↔ Rs 78.24 cr; Medico Remedies: USD 1,406,450 ↔ Rs 13.38 cr), both implying ~Rs 95/USD — on that rate the order is on the order of **Rs 2,000 cr, ~6% of Sterlite's Rs 32,615 cr market cap**, and the largest award on the tape today. *(The auto baseline listed this with no value at all: the amount lives in the Annexure-A table, not the covering letter, so `amount_rs` stored 0 and the row could never reach movers.)*

receives a **Letter of Acceptance from SAIL – IISCO Steel Plant, Burnpur** for the **Pellet Plant BOP including Civil & Structural (Pellet Package-2)** of the 4.08 MTPA crude-steel expansion. The annexure gives the exact figure — **Rs 854,56,71,234, net of input tax credit** — over **32 months** from the effective date. At ~75% of a Rs 1,143 cr market cap this is a step-change in the order book for a company of this size, and it is a public-sector counterparty, so execution risk sits in the schedule rather than in collection.

intimates work orders of **Rs 801.20 cr (excluding GST)** in the ordinary course. The composition matters more than the total: **Rs 780.38 cr of it is a single PMC mandate from the Reserve Bank of India** — its Amaravati office complex at Nelapadu plus the officers'/staff residential complex at Inavolu — with only Rs 20.82 cr from the Odisha School Education Programme Authority for DA-JGUA hostels. As project-management consultancy the revenue is fee-based, not construction turnover.

receives a **Rs 400 cr rural water-supply order** — tube wells, rising mains, overhead tanks, pump houses, distribution networks, individual house connections and public stand posts — with the single-village scheme due by **March 2027** and the multi-village scheme by **March 2028**. The awarder is **M/s NKG Primus JV**, a private joint venture, so this is sub-contracted scheme work rather than a direct government mandate. At ~21% of a Rs 1,913 cr market cap it is the largest domestic-rupee award of the day after SEPC. *(Held out of the baseline's movers with no value: the figure is in the annexure. The row also arrives BSE-only with no ISIN and a sentinel 'NAN' ticker — AXISOL resolved here from the security master via BSE code 511144, not guessed.)*

movers.quantum: Rs 344.10 cr aggregate (Rs 333.80 cr PGVCL); ~96% of mcap
movers.headline: reports orders **aggregating Rs 344.10 cr**, of which **Rs 333.80 cr is 12 Letters of Acceptance from Paschim Gujarat Vij Company (PGVCL)** — turnkey conversion of existing 11 kV HT and LT networks to underground cable with a Ring Main System, GIS mapping and asset tagging, across four circles (**Bhavnagar 9 packages / Rs 251.21 cr, Jamnagar Rs 35.98 cr, Anjar Rs 28.26 cr, Junagadh Rs 18.36 cr**), executable over 12–18 months. The remaining **Rs 10.30 cr** is three smaller wins: Genus Power Rs 5.02 cr, Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Rs 2.84 cr and a Telangana Southern Power Distribution LoI of Rs 2.44 cr. **The aggregate — not the PGVCL leg — is the day's number**, and at Rs 344.10 cr it is ~96% of a Rs 357 cr market cap.

wins a **Rs 256.89 cr work order (including GST) from the Water Resources Department, Birpur, Bihar** — raising, strengthening and flexible-pavement construction over **31.985 km**, with 7 studs restored and 13 new studs built, under the Bihar Water Security and Irrigation Modernization Project, over **32 months**. The quantum is real and the market cap is not stale (Rs 172 cr at capture, Rs 174 cr on the current security master), so the ~1.5× ratio stands — but read it with the filing's own wording: the award is to **"Niraj Cement Structurals Limited JV"**, and **the filing nowhere states Niraj's share of that JV**. The headline ratio is therefore an upper bound on what accrues to this balance sheet.

movers.quantum: Rs 186.30 cr project cost; ~16.8% of mcap
movers.headline: approves a **denim garment facility at an approximate project cost of Rs 186.30 cr**, in **joint venture with NDS9 Private Limited**, to be funded **30% equity / 70% term loans** and housed in a new company, **LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited**, which becomes an RSWM subsidiary on incorporation. At ~17% of market cap this is the largest capacity commitment on the tape. *(The auto baseline dropped this from **every** theme, not just movers: the surviving row's text says "term loans", and the digest's debt filter removes any line matching that phrase unless it also carries a fresh-equity signal. A project's funding mix is not a debt raise.)*

discloses orders of **INR 2,133.91 mn (Rs 213.39 cr) from DRDO, defence PSUs and private industries**, in the ordinary course. The RSS subject tag reads *"General Updates"* — the same subject-vs-content shape that buried Tata Steel's Rs 33,873 cr on 30-Jul — but the filing's own subject line reads "Business Updates" and the body is unambiguous, so it belongs in orders and the classifier already placed it there. The filing does **not** break the figure down by customer or give an execution period; at ~1.5% of a Rs 14,258 cr market cap it is small relative to the company.

order_wins: **Sterlite Technologies** — ~**USD 210 mn** high-density optical-fibre-cable supply agreement, CY27–29, international counterparty named only as a "leading telecom infrastructure company" (≈Rs 2,000 cr at the ~Rs 95/USD implied by two other filings the same day; ~6% of mcap).
**SEPC** — Rs 854.57 cr LoA from SAIL–IISCO Burnpur, Pellet Plant BOP for the 4.08 MTPA crude-steel expansion, 32 months, net of ITC (~74.8% of mcap).
**NBCC (India)** — Rs 801.20 cr excl. GST, of which Rs 780.38 cr is RBI Amaravati project-management consultancy and Rs 20.82 cr Odisha hostels (~3.1% of mcap).
**Axis Solutions** — Rs 400 cr rural water-supply order from M/s NKG Primus JV; single-village scheme to Mar-2027, multi-village to Mar-2028 (~20.9% of mcap).
**RMC Switchgears** — Rs 344.10 cr aggregate; Rs 333.80 cr is 12 PGVCL LoAs for 11 kV/LT underground cabling across four circles, 12–18 months (~96% of mcap).

**Niraj Cement Structurals** — Rs 256.89 cr incl. GST from the Water Resources Department, Birpur, Bihar; 31.985 km of flexible pavement, 32 months. Awarded to "Niraj Cement Structurals Limited JV" — the filing does not state Niraj's JV share (~149.6% of mcap).
**Apollo Micro Systems** — Rs 213.39 cr (INR 2,133.91 mn) from DRDO, defence PSUs and private industries; no customer split and no execution period in the filing (~1.5% of mcap).

**Interarch Building Solutions** — Rs 83 cr pre-engineered steel building system for a major energy-transmission project; ~16-month completion, 10% advance. **The customer is withheld** for confidentiality (~2.7% of mcap).

**Panacea Biotec** — Letter of Award from **UNICEF** for bivalent Oral Polio Vaccine, **US$8.205 mn (~Rs 78.24 cr)** for supply in calendar 2028 (~3.0% of mcap). *Quantified in the filing; the baseline carried it unvalued.*

**Omfurn India** — **Rs 38.88 cr** (Rs 3,888.07 lakh, exclusive of taxes) of pre-finished wooden doors and frames with installation for **Oberoi Realty and Incline Realty**, delivery by 31-Dec-2026, across Oberoi Elysian Towers A/B and Skycity Towers F/G. Unexecuted order book past **Rs 170 cr** at 31-Jul-2026 (~51% of mcap — *not* the ~14% the baseline printed).

**Kotyark Industries** — LoIs from **BPCL (1,287 KL) and HPCL (375 KL)** for biodiesel, 1,662 KL aggregating **~Rs 15.41 cr** (BPCL Rs 11.93 cr + HPCL Rs 3.48 cr) for the Jun–Aug 2026 supply window (~3.7% of mcap). *Quantified in the filing; the baseline carried it unvalued.*

**Medico Remedies** — order from **PROMESE/CAL, Dominican Republic**, USD 1,406,450 ≈ **Rs 13.38 cr**, full supply within 3 months (~3.3% of mcap). *Quantified in the filing; the baseline carried it unvalued.*
**Veerhealth Care** — repeat order worth **Rs 5.27 cr** for face-care products from a leading Indian FMCG company (~6.0% of an Rs 88 cr market cap).

**Abhishek Integrations** — Rs 1,78,13,256 (**Rs 1.78 cr**, incl. duties and taxes) from the Airports Authority of India for 24-month O&M of ground lighting, standby DG sets and power supply at HAL Airport, Bengaluru (~8.2% of a Rs 21.6 cr market cap).

**Waaree Renewable Technologies** — turnkey contract for **210 MWp (150 MWac)**, completion in FY2027-28. **The filing gives no rupee value** — the order size is stated only in MW — and the awarder **SHEPL is a step-down subsidiary of Waaree Energies**, i.e. an intra-group award.
**Shayona Engineering** — purchase orders of Rs 1.15 cr (~2.2% of mcap).
_Not new orders:_ **Rox Hi-Tech** (Cisco Preferred Partner status — a certification, not an award) and **Axis Solutions' second row** (an earnings-call intimation).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **OBSC Perfection** — board approves a **Rs 86.52 cr preferential issue**: 14,39,600 equity shares at **Rs 601** (Rs 10 face + Rs 591 premium) to two non-promoter allottees named in the filing — **Sixteenth Street Asian Gems Fund (11,64,800 shares)** and **Flamboyawer Finance Private Limited (2,74,800)** — alongside an authorised-capital increase from Rs 27 cr to Rs 30 cr. Subject to shareholder approval at an **EGM on 2-Sep-2026**, so it is a **proposed** allotment, not an executed one (~4.9% of mcap). *(The baseline demoted this to "enabling resolution" on the EGM-notice wording; the preferential issue itself is a real, priced, named-allottee board approval.)*

**Krishival Foods** — receives **Rs 54,05,65,935** as the first and final call of Rs 195/share on 27,72,120 partly paid rights shares, now converted to fully paid. Real cash, but the **collection of a rights issue offered in December 2025**, not a new raise — and **5,61,040 partly paid shares remain unpaid**, with reminder notices to follow.
**Suraj Estate Developers** — a Management Committee meeting is *scheduled* for 10-Aug-2026 to consider up to **Rs 165 cr of secured NCDs**. Debt, and not yet approved.

**Jammu & Kashmir Bank**, **Arvind** (QIP finance-committee outcome), **Tuni Textile Mills**, **Consecutive Commodities**, **Vellora Impact** — raise plumbing: board meetings called, modalities fixed, rights allotments made. None quantified as fresh capital today.
m_and_a: **TVS Motor** — composite scheme amalgamating **STPL Trading and Services**, **Home Credit India Finance** and **TVS Housing Finance** into **TVS Credit Services**. Home Credit India is the substance: **total assets Rs 8,367.07 cr, net worth Rs 2,957.81 cr, turnover Rs 619.70 cr** at 30-Jun-2026 — an RBI-registered NBFC in retail financing folded into the group's credit arm. Consideration was fixed by an independent registered valuer (Bansi S Mehta Valuers LLP) but **no consideration figure or swap ratio is disclosed** in the filing.

**Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services** — board approves a scheme of merger; the share-exchange ratio rests on a Bansi S. Mehta valuation with an Ernst & Young Merchant Banking fairness opinion. **The ratio itself is not stated in this filing.**

**Maithan Alloys** — bought **14,83,256 shares (0.29%) of Sterlite Technologies for Rs 91.24 cr cash on 4-Aug-2026** through the stock exchange, disclosed on threshold trigger. The filing is explicit that it is an **investment and that Maithan does not intend to acquire control** — a treasury position, ~3.2% of Maithan's own market cap. *(The baseline carried this unvalued.)*

**L.T. Elevator** — signs a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire **DYPC Inc. (Dongyang PC), Seoul**, a maker of automated mechanical car-parking systems. **The consideration is not disclosed anywhere in the release.** What is disclosed: DYPC brings a **~Rs 65 cr order book (incl. Rs 45 cr won last week)**, a **Rs 700 cr bid pipeline** (~Rs 550 cr of it in the USA), one Rs 8 cr US order, and **12 patents**; management guides **~Rs 30 cr of revenue contribution** for the remainder of this fiscal. Unquantified on price, so not a mover.

**Shalimar Paints** — subsidiary **Shalimar Adhunik Nirman** signs an agreement to sell its plot at Sector 32, Urban Estate Gurgaon II for **Rs 50 cr**, completion expected 20-Nov-2026, buyer Sparton Growth Comtrade Private Limited. Worth noting against the disclosed subsidiary financials: **net worth Rs 14.74 cr and nil income** — so this is a well-above-book monetisation of a dormant asset, ~6.9% of the parent's market cap. An **agreement to sell**, not a completed disposal.

**Goyal Salt** — Rs 45.90 lakh into the rights issue of its subsidiary Goyal Foods Industries Private Limited, taking it to 51% post-allotment. *(This is the row the baseline led with as a marquee ★ — see the correction above.)*
**Elpro International** — acquisition at a cost of **Rs 5.00 cr**.

**Aurobindo Pharma** — merger of two wholly-owned step-down subsidiaries into a WOS; **Crisil** — amalgamation of Crisil Canada Inc. and Crisil PriceMetrix Inc.; **Adani Power** — update on its scheme of amalgamation; **TVS Holdings** and **The Sandesh** — amalgamation intimations. Internal reorganisations, none quantified.

**Aster DM Quality Care** — acquires equity shares of United CIIGMA Institute of Medical Sciences, an existing subsidiary; **KRM Ayurveda** — acquires 100% of an unnamed target; **Bikaji Foods** — investment in C.G. Bikaji Private Limited, a Nepal JV, plus a new Abu Dhabi WOS. None carry a consideration in the filing.
capex_core: **RSWM** — Rs 186.30 cr denim garment facility in JV with NDS9 Private Limited, 30% equity / 70% term loans, through new subsidiary LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited (~16.8% of mcap). *The day's largest capacity commitment; dropped from every theme in the baseline.*

**Neuland Laboratories** — filed under a *"Capacity addition"* subject, but the board item is a **Rs 40 cr corporate guarantee in favour of Gland Pharma** under a Loan Licence Agreement, and it is **Gland** that establishes the dedicated capacity and incurs the capex. Neuland's exposure is contingent, not a plant. *(Correctly flagged as a subject/content mismatch — but the mismatch overstates, it does not understate.)*

**Chalet Hotels** — two ATHIVA-branded developments added to the pipeline, **150 keys in Hyderabad and 231 keys in Pune**, on a capital-efficient lease model with capex incurred only post-handover of the building. **The filing does not quantify the capex.**

**Hatsun Agro Product** — a Business Line article the company circulated reports a planned **~Rs 1,000 cr of investment in FY27**. This is a chairman's interview, **not a board-approved capex**, and no filing on the tape approves it.

**Tinna Rubber & Infrastructure** — funds **not exceeding Rs 15 cr** into Tinna Rubber Arabia (Saudi WOS) in tranches; **first tranche actually infused SAR 3,40,000 ≈ Rs 0.87 cr**. Own-subsidiary infusion — real cash, but group plumbing.
**JK Lakshmi Cement** — up to **Rs 20.50 cr** for a minimum 26% of **STLC RE 1 Limited**, an SPV for solar power under the group-captive route. Captive power, so it buys cost, not topline.

**Vinyas Innovative Technologies** / **Paradeep Phosphates** / **Oriana Power** — new wholly-owned subsidiaries subscribed at face value (Vinyas' initial investment is up to USD 3,000). Incorporation paperwork, not capacity.
business_updates: **Results season** — 199 companies filed results / earnings-call material on the day (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations). Collapsed here; tracked in the Results tab.
**Paisalo Digital** — disbursements **+128% YoY**, AUM **Rs 67,074 mn, +28% YoY**.
**Dredging Corporation of India** — Q1 operational income **+46.73%**.
**Smartworks Coworking Spaces** — enters Aerocity, Delhi NCR with a **~1.41 lakh sq ft** managed office at 4 Worldmark.
**Wipro** — launches Enterprise Resilience as a Service with Rubrik; **Urban Company** — launches Native M3 Pro with a 3-year unconditional warranty. Product/partnership news, unquantified.
**Amrutanjan Health Care** — commencement of commercial production; **Jain Resource Recycling** — cleared to resume manufacturing at its Unit-II facility, including the fire-affected shed.
distress_risk: **Corporate insolvency:** **Shrenik Limited** — NCLT admits the application and CIRP begins. **DPSC**, **Future Enterprises** (43rd CoC), **JCT** (15th CoC) and **Tricom Fruit Products** (17th CoC) file routine process intimations on cases already running.

**Litigation:** **Oil India** — update on tax litigations; **JSW Dulux** — pendency of litigation with potential impact; **Jayshree Chemicals** — Grasim arbitration (Petition 61 of 2024); **Prime Focus** — disposal of its suit against Reliance Alpha Services. None quantified.
other_notable: **SIS** — board approves a **Rs 106 cr buyback through the open-market route**, at a maximum price of **Rs 478.50/share**, for up to **22,15,256 shares ≈ 1.57% of paid-up equity** (excluding transaction costs and buyback tax). This is a **capital return, not an order** — and open-market buybacks are executed at management's discretion over time, so the Rs 106 cr is a ceiling on cash out, not a committed spend.

**Orbit Exports** — **post**-buyback public announcement: 8,90,822 shares at Rs 250 = **Rs 22,27,05,500**, tender-offer route, record date 15-Jul-2026. A completed transaction being reported under Reg 24(vi) — a compliance filing, not a new event.
**Kirloskar Pneumatic** — record date for its stock split fixed at 18-Aug-2026.

**Held out as extraction artefacts:** Rolex Rings' "Rs 180 cr buyback" (the filing is a bare Q1 results board outcome), Modulex Construction's "Rs 62.92 cr allotment" (Q1 results plus a Reg-32 deviation statement on past preferential proceeds), Mindspace REIT's "Rs 221.11 cr" (a results board outcome; trusts are never movers) and Muthoot Microfin's commercial-paper row (debt, and the stored amount is off by orders of magnitude).

**Debt / lagging signals, dropped per §3:** Bank of Maharashtra NCD interest certificate, Suraj Estate's proposed Rs 165 cr NCDs, CESC's debt-securities allotment, and the day's credit-rating actions (D-Mart, UGRO, Welspun Corp, AVP Infracon among them).

tally: 2026-08-05: 2,329 announcements captured (00:02–23:59 IST), 648 material rows -> 8 verified movers. The day's biggest award is one the auto baseline could not see: **Sterlite Technologies' ~USD 210 mn optical-fibre supply agreement** for CY27–29, whose value sits in the SEBI annexure rather than the covering letter and so stored as zero. On the ~Rs 95/USD that two other filings the same day imply, that is on the order of **Rs 2,000 cr** — larger than **SEPC's Rs 854.57 cr SAIL-Burnpur pellet-plant LoA**, which is nonetheless the more consequential item at ~75% of its market cap. **Axis Solutions' Rs 400 cr** rural water-supply order (~21% of mcap) was held out the same way. **NBCC's Rs 801.20 cr** is 97% one RBI Amaravati PMC mandate. **RMC's Rs 344.10 cr aggregate** and **Niraj's Rs 256.89 cr** both sit near or above their own market caps — Niraj's, read carefully, is an award to a **JV whose profit share the filing never states**. **RSWM's Rs 186.30 cr denim JV** — the largest capacity commitment of the day at ~17% of mcap — had vanished from the baseline entirely, killed by a debt filter matching the words "term loans" in its own funding mix. Six baseline entries were corrected out, led by **Goyal Salt's marquee ★**, which was the English word "ambit" in "falls within the ambit of a related party transaction" and not an allottee at all; **Omfurn's Rs 10.65 cr** was one of four project lines against a filed total of **Rs 38.88 cr**, which is ~51% of its market cap. Capital returns, not orders: **SIS' Rs 106 cr open-market buyback** (a ceiling, executed at discretion) and **Orbit Exports' completed Rs 22.27 cr tender offer**. The largest restructuring is **TVS Credit absorbing Home Credit India Finance** (total assets Rs 8,367.07 cr) — with no consideration disclosed.
